score_semantics: Source-contract confidence only; not parcel-result or numeric elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons monthly download
verified_facts: The service publishes indicative extents and positions of registered freehold properties in England and Wales
Download files are organised by local authority
New files are published on the first Sunday of every month
A GIS is required to view the GML polygon files
semantic_limits: The dataset covers registered freehold property rather than every possible parcel or leasehold interest
A polygon crossing a local-authority boundary can occur in more than one authority file
The monthly snapshot must be recorded with its publication date and file hash

candidates.name: Technical guidance for HMLR GML files
verified_facts: HM Land Registry polygons are captured against the British National Grid
The guidance identifies EPSG:27700 as the source projection used for the polygon data
The GML can be converted into other GIS formats
Reprojection from British National Grid to WGS84 can shift some features by up to 15 metres
semantic_limits: Display reprojection is not parcel-identity evidence
Exact polygon-to-raster joins must remain in a controlled native CRS
Any transformed display geometry must retain the original source geometry and transformation metadata

candidates.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data guidance
verified_facts: Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
The ID relates to a registered title
The polygons show the position and indicative extent of registered property
The files are supplied in GML format
semantic_limits: Indicative extent is not a substitute for the legal title plan or register
An INSPIRE ID alone does not prove the canonical shard row
The exact geometry and source snapshot must be retained with any match

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 metadata specification
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 provides GEMINI metadata on a per-tile basis
Metadata identifies whether the spatial representation is grid DTM or vector contours
Metadata records the 5km National Grid tile reference and British National Grid CRS
Version, reason for change and lineage are represented in the tile metadata
semantic_limits: Metadata does not contain the sampled parcel result
The exact metadata record must match the tile bytes used for the crosscheck
A later tile version cannot silently replace the version originally sampled

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 grid data specification
verified_facts: The GML carries metadata while the ASCII grid is the external block containing spatial height values
Each grid height is calculated as the mean height across a 5m pixel
Grid values are positioned at pixel centres with a 2.5m offset from the tile edge
Height values are supplied to the nearest 0.01m and each tile has a metadata file
semantic_limits: The GML file alone cannot produce a height result
A 5m pixel mean is not an exact point or parcel-edge elevation
Flying date, tile identity and pixel-centre semantics must accompany every secondary value
